findings.reason: extending DataSystemBase keeps the single config path every scanner already reads and removes the two-surfaces-drift the plan cites as its motivation; a new block forks it.
findings.text: the plan introduces a new facility-level remote_environment block instead of extending the DataSystemBase mixin that already defines setup_commands/python_command for every data system (EDASConfig et al. mix it in, scanners read config.get("setup_commands")/config.get("python_command"), parallel.py merges it)

findings.reason: the missed search result is precisely the mechanism to extend, so both the premise and the chosen surface change.
findings.text: the plan's premise "that knowledge lives in two loosely typed keys under one data system" is inaccurate: get_facility already returns facility-wide config and the DataSystemBase mixin already generalizes those two keys across all data systems, so the plan proposes new surface without having cited the owner it should extend

findings.reason: the section must account for the added interface surface by stating the merge or why nothing can be retired, which the review item exists to force.
findings.text: §6 adds the remote_environment block (four fields) and the interpreter-floor/module-importability probe results as new definition surface without naming in its own text what it retires or merges; the per-data-system keys are kept as an "optional override" so both surfaces persist

duplicate_owner-1.reason: A code scan, a path scan and the facility tool probe have no data system, so the DataSystemBase mixin cannot carry the host-wide interpreter recipe they need; the facility block is that default and the mixin keys stay as the per-data-system override (TCV mdsplus sources a different profile from a plain python call). The genuine duplicate is data_access_patterns.setup_commands, which no code reads: §6 now retires it into the block.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §2 extends FacilitySignal with three typed slots through the existing schema/build-models path, §3 adds one property to WikiPage and reuses the existing chunk edge, and §6 hides the block+override merge behind one resolver function rather than spreading wrappers.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §6 adds a facility-level remote_environment block beside the existing DataSystemBase mixin (imas_codex/schemas/facility_config.yaml:426) whose setup_commands/python_command every scanner already reads and which imas_codex/discovery/signals/parallel.py already merges.
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §6 adds the remote_environment block (setup_commands, python_command, interpreter floor, required modules) while retaining the per-data-system keys as an override, so it names no retirement or merge of the surface §6 itself says is already duplicated.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §3 correctly reuses the existing WikiChunk-[:DOCUMENTS]->FacilitySignal edge (created at imas_codex/discovery/wiki/pipeline.py:318, read at imas_codex/llm/search_tools.py:818) and §6 reuses check_all_tools, but §6's prior-art premise that the remote-environment knowledge lives in "two loosely typed keys under one data system" misses the DataSystemBase mixin at imas_codex/schemas/facility_config.yaml:426, which already carries setup_commands and python_command for every data system.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the §6 resolver adds real merge behaviour (facility block plus per-data-system override) over the existing facility-config read; it is not a forwarding shim, and the check-stage change extends the existing check_edas.py rather than adding a parallel script.
